items.exampleEn: This old recording of my grandmother's voice is very special to me.
items.exampleZh: 這段奶奶聲音的舊錄音對我來說很特別。

items.exampleEn: My little brother is afraid of the monster in that movie.
items.exampleZh: 我弟弟怕那部電影裡的怪物。

items.exampleEn: Hold the bow with your left hand.
The old arrows in the museum are made of wood.
items.exampleZh: 博物館裡那些古老的箭是木頭做的。

items.exampleEn: Funny videos always entertain my kids.
items.exampleZh: 好笑的影片總能讓我的孩子開心。

items.exampleEn: The creator of this cartoon is only twenty-five.
items.exampleZh: 這部卡通的創作者才二十五歲。
這個合唱團有四十名團員。

items.exampleEn: In the story, the girl finds a magical ring.
items.exampleZh: 故事裡，女孩找到一枚有魔力的戒指。

items.sentenceEn: Follow the arrows to find the exit.

items.audioEn: The choir will practice on Tuesday and Thursday evenings this month.
items.audioZh: 合唱團這個月星期二和星期四晚上練習。
items.questionZh: 合唱團這個月什麼時候練習？

items.sentenceEn: It was a magical evening by the lake.
items.sentenceZh: 那是在湖邊度過的一個夢幻夜晚。

items.sentenceEn: We listened to a recording of the concert.
items.sentenceZh: 我們聽了那場音樂會的錄音。

items.stemEn: In the story, a scary ____ lived under the bridge.
items.stemZh: 故事裡，橋下住著一隻可怕的怪物。

items.stemEn: The singer told jokes to ____ the guests between songs.
items.stemZh: 歌手在歌曲之間講笑話娛樂來賓。

items.passageEn: At summer camp, we tried many new activities. In the morning, we learned to shoot arrows with a bow. In the afternoon, the camp choir practiced songs for the last night. One evening, a camp leader entertained us with a story about a monster in the lake. On the last night, we made a recording of our songs on a tablet, and the creator of our camp song gave a short speech. Everything felt magical under the stars.
items.passageZh: 在夏令營，我們嘗試了很多新活動。早上，我們學用弓射箭。下午，營隊合唱團為最後一晚練唱。有一天晚上，一位營隊領隊講了一個湖裡怪物的故事逗我們開心。最後一晚，我們用平板錄下我們的歌，我們營歌的創作者也發表了簡短的演說。在星空下，一切都感覺好夢幻。

questions.questionZh: 最後一晚他們做了什麼？

items.promptZh: 他用弓和箭射中了目標。
referenceEn: He hit the target with his bow and arrow.
Using a bow and arrow, he hit the target.
rubricZh: bow 在這裡是名詞「弓」，例如 a bow and arrow 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式）

items.instructionZh: 用 choir 造一個句子，說說你或認識的人參加合唱團的經驗。
referenceEn: I sang in a choir when I was in high school.
My aunt has sung in a choir for twenty years.
rubricZh: choir 表示「合唱團」，例如 sing in a choir 等說法
時態配合內容（例如過去式、現在完成式等）
